entities.name: PHD finger protein 23A
observations: Exact sequence match to the 296-residue query; UniProt Q5BJ10, Danio rerio.
Curated function: negative regulator of autophagy; associated with negative regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation and positive regulation of protein ubiquitination.
Predicted sequence properties: molecular weight 33,431 Da, theoretical pI 6.17, GRAVY -0.772, estimated charge at pH 7 -5.32.
Contains a C-terminal PHD-type zinc-finger region; Pfam PHD detected at residues 242–284 and PHD_2 at residues 252–284.
N-terminal and central regions are rich in Lys/Arg, Ser, Pro, and acidic residues, consistent with disordered and regulatory segments; instability index is 58.3.
Exact sequence annotation does not establish biochemical substrate specificity or a direct molecular mechanism.

entities.name: PHD-type zinc finger
observations: Pfam PHD and PHD_2 evidence supports a C-terminal PHD-type zinc-finger domain spanning approximately residues 242–284 of the query.
The sequence contains a cysteine/histidine-rich C-terminal region compatible with zinc coordination, but ligand-binding specificity is not established by sequence alone.

entities.name: Autophagy
observations: The exact matched reference is annotated as a negative regulator of autophagy, including inhibition of autophagosome assembly and maturation.
